title: Gibson P-90 / P-100 Soapbar Pickup Cover, Cream

long_description.body: The P-90 In the 1950s and early ’60s the P-90 was standard equipment on the first Les Pauls, the “Goldtop” models of ’52-’56, and from the mid-’50s through most of the following decades continued to power the popular Les Paul and SG Junior and Special models that many rock, blues and punk players have wielded with such force. These P-90 / P-100 Pickup Covers look fantastic whether you choose the "Dog Ear" or "Soapbar" covers.
